false_negative_deep_dive.explanation: Students whose early indicators (Quiz 1, early attendance) appeared acceptable, but who experienced steep disengagement in weeks 6-8 or catastrophic final exam drops. Because the model strictly avoids future leakage, sudden unmeasured shocks post-Week 8 cannot be foreseen.
false_negative_deep_dive.business_cost: High - Struggling student fails without receiving intervention outreach.
false_negative_deep_dive.mitigation: Lower the operational advisory threshold to 0.35-0.40 to capture borderline cases.

false_positive_deep_dive.explanation: Students who exhibited weak mid-term signals (e.g. low Quiz 2 or delayed assignments) but subsequently recovered during the second half of the semester through unrecorded private tutoring or intense revision.
false_positive_deep_dive.business_cost: Low - Student receives an optional supportive mentoring invitation. Non-punitive.
false_positive_deep_dive.mitigation: Advisors provide gentle check-ins rather than mandatory remediation.
